## 自检清单 / Checklist

- [ ] 已添加或更新测试，本地 `pytest` 全部通过 / Tests added or updated; `pytest` passes locally
- [ ] 代码、测试、截图和提交信息里**没有真实数据**（论文标题、稿件编号、人名、邮箱、OpenReview forum ID、PDF、数据库），只用合成数据 / **No real data** anywhere (titles, manuscript numbers, names, emails, forum ids, PDFs, databases); synthetic data only
- [ ] 用户能看到的行为变化已更新文档（`README.md`、`README.en.md` 等）/ Docs updated for user-visible changes
- [ ] 没有新增对外网络请求、遥测或 CDN 资源；新增依赖已先在 issue 里讨论 / No new outbound requests, telemetry or CDN assets; new dependencies discussed in an issue first
- [ ] 界面文字为中文，与现有用语一致 / UI text is in Chinese and consistent with existing wording
- [ ] 我同意以 AGPL-3.0-or-later 授权本次贡献 / I agree to license this contribution under AGPL-3.0-or-later
